title: StegGuard: your text has characters you can't see
excerpt: StegGuard finds invisible Unicode, homoglyphs, Trojan Source overrides, whitespace channels and watermark signals in code, documents, images and audio. Python standard library only, offline by default.
content_html:
Open source · v0.6.0 on PyPI · Apache-2.0 · alpha

StegGuard finds them. It scans files for zero-width characters, homoglyphs, whitespace channels and watermark signals. If it finds a hidden message it can decode it, and it can remove hidden characters from plain text while preserving your original. Python standard library only, offline by default.

Install StegGuardTry it on your textSee it run on seven sample filesCLI reference

Read-only sample. Enable JavaScript to check your own text.

What StegGuard sees

Q3 numbers are final.16 zero-width Please summarize them for the U+202E RLOboard.

  • 16 zero-width characters spell "hi" in binary.
  • A right-to-left override (U+202E) reverses how the text after it is drawn.
01 / How it works

One workflow instead of several one-off tools.

This example scans a plain-text file, reads its hidden message and removes the hidden characters from a copy. Your original stays as it is unless you ask for an in-place rewrite.

  1. 01 / Detect

    Point it at a file or a whole repo.

    Runs on the standard library, with no network calls. It exits with 1 when something is flagged, so CI can fail the build.

  2. 02 / Decode

    Read the hidden message without touching the file.

    The result is JSON, with a confidence score for each channel.

  3. 03 / Sanitize

    Write a plain-text copy and review the changes.

    The copy goes to report.sanitized.txt by default. Overwriting the original takes --in-place and --confirm together.

02 / Integrations

Put it where hidden text gets in.

Scan pull requests, commits, scraped pages and files before anyone, or any model, reads them.

GitHub Actions

Fails the pull request when any file in the checkout is flagged. Directories need -r to be scanned recursively.

pre-commit

A local hook, since the package doesn't ship a .pre-commit-hooks.yaml yet. pre-commit passes the staged file names.

Python

analyze_file takes a Path and returns a dict. total_hidden is set for text and binary files alike.

CLI

The same three steps as the workflow above. Rewriting the original takes --in-place and --confirm together.

03 / Coverage

Hidden content rarely comes in one neat format.

Files StegGuard can scan
  • build.log
  • logo.png
  • report.pdf
  • Dockerfile
  • voice.wav
  • release.zip
  • app.ts
  • clip.mp4
  • module.wasm
View format support ↗

Text and source

Zero-width Unicode, bidirectional overrides, Cyrillic and Greek homoglyphs, trailing-space and tab channels, mixed line endings.

Read the docs: Text and source

Images, audio and media

Pixel-level LSB anomalies (chi-square, RS, entropy, sample-pair), PNG private chunks, JPEG EXIF/XMP/IPTC, PCM audio statistics.

Read the docs: Images, audio and media

Documents and containers

PDF embedded files, DOCX/PPTX/XLSX/ZIP members, nested archives, hidden content in SVG and HTML.

Read the docs: Documents and containers

Watermarks and provenance

Metadata, structural and text-pattern evidence, device fingerprints, and C2PA manifests validated through c2patool.

Read the docs: Watermarks and provenance
04 / Use cases

Where it fits

CI gate
Fail a pull request that adds BIDI overrides or homoglyphs to source files.

LLM input checks
Look for zero-width prompt injection in pasted text and scraped pages before they reach a model.

Pre-publish checks
Scan DOCX, PPTX and PDF files for hidden content before you send them out.

Provenance audits
Validate C2PA Content Credentials and look for watermark signals before you trust an image or audio file.

05 / Trust

Read the source before you trust it.

StegGuard is alpha software. Treat what it reports as evidence to check, not a final verdict.

License
Apache-2.0

Dependencies
Python standard library only (Pillow is optional, for images)

Network
Offline by default

Run in CI on every push and pull request
